subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add a configurable non-USD currency contract for local model-cost estimates, and if so should it be provider-scoped, model-scoped, global, or display-only?
rationale: This changes public config and cost/accounting semantics across status output, reply usage, Control UI usage analysis, docs, and USD-named local estimate paths, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Design Currency Contract First
options.body: Choose scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, persisted naming, docs, and migration expectations before implementation.

options.title: Keep Local Estimates USD-Only
options.body: Document configured model costs as USD per million tokens and leave non-USD values to provider-reported billing surfaces.

options.title: Allow Display-Only Override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol or ISO display override while explicitly preserving USD-shaped storage and aggregate semantics.

recommendation.title: Design Currency Contract First
recommendation.body: Choose scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, persisted naming, docs, and migration expectations before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent usage, provider-billing, provider cost-history, and provider-plan work make this the closest current product/data-contract ownership trail.
